review_criteria: The title and section provide enough context for the passage.
The passage is not site navigation, an orphaned cross-reference index, or an unlabelled trailing fragment.
Code fences are balanced and SQL syntax or command examples retain their lexical form.
Error references retain every symbol, numeric code, SQLSTATE, placeholder, and message field available upstream.
Converted tables retain header-to-value relationships and remain readable.

non_failing_observations.note: The pinned MySQL error catalogue itself supplies only the message placeholder %s for these symbols. The pipeline preserves that upstream limitation verbatim together with the symbol and error number.

Some MySQL and MariaDB HELP catalogue examples are source-authored as inline terminal transcripts instead of fenced Markdown. SQL identifiers, statements, result columns, warning or error numbers, and values remain present and inspectable.
The SQL detector is deliberately lexical and can conservatively flag prose beginning with a SQL keyword such as update. This affects the contains_sql label only and does not alter text.
